title: Part Fifteen: The Bill and America's Role

sections.brief: What the 2016 MOU's $3.8bn/yr is ($3.3bn FMF + $500m missile defence), lump-sum disbursement, offshore procurement phase-out to FY2028; aid since Oct 2023 (Iron Dome transfer, April 2024 supplemental, arms sales, Costs of War $21.7bn); share of defence budget and GDP 2011 vs 2025–26; fungibility tested (Bandow, National Interest 2016, loan-guarantee deductions vs OSP end, shrinking share, Bank of Israel war cost, Netanyahu's phase-out and the new-MOU talks). Figures: flow; stats; compare

Israel's bill (Bank of Israel NIS 352bn 2023–26, June 2025 compensation, Finance Ministry NIS 35bn for the 2026 Iran war, defence % GDP, deficit and debt, special US grant); the US bill (FY2024 regional ops, Red Sea and Rough Rider, interceptors 2024–25, Midnight Hammer, Costs of War totals, CENTCOM $43.6bn for 2026); what the two bills show. Figures: stats; money

Every US service death in these theatres since Oct 2023 by date, place, branch, cause (SEALs Jan 2024, Tower 22, Gaza pier, the 21 of the 2026 war per DCAS 9 Oct 2026, total 28 after the audit added the USS Mason death); American civilians (33 on 7 Oct, five in the West Bank to July 2025, WCK's Flickinger, Corrie 2003, Abu Akleh 2022) with Israeli and other accounts; the 'dragged in' argument, both sides (link ir14_who, ir12_question).
